cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air France 126, destination Beijing, 8900 meters maintaining, over Tango Mike Romeo, Tango Zulu Hotel 10, squawk 6021, now contact  Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Air France 126，目的地北京，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021，现在联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR126，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, radar contact, negative short cut, over fly Tango Zulu Hotel due to Air Force activity.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，北京管制，squawk 6021，雷达联系。因空军活动，不能直飞，需飞越TZH。
cards.referenceText: Radar contact, over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达联系，因空军活动飞越TZH，AFR126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask the controller which runway is in use.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问管制员当前使用跑道。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, request runway in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR126，请问使用跑道。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, expect Kilo Mike 01 arrival, runway in use 36 left.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，预计KM01进场，使用跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计KM01进场，使用跑道36L，AFR126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask whether you can use Kilo Mike 03 arrival and land on runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问是否可以使用KM03进场并在01跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: If available, request KM03 arrival, land on runway 01, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如可用，申请KM03进场，01跑道落地，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, after Kilo Mike, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，过KM后可以向北京进近申请更换跑道。
cards.referenceText: After KM, request change runway, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM后申请更换跑道，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, descend to and maintain 4500 meters over Kilo Mike.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，过KM下降并保持4500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM下降并保持4500米，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 119.7, good day, AFR126.

cards.audioText: B: Over Kilo Mike, maintaining 4500 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request runway 01, Kilo Mike 03 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 过KM，保持4500米，联系北京进近并申请01跑道、KM03进场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, over KM, 4500 meters maintaining, request runway 01 KM03 arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，过KM，保持4500米，申请01跑道KM03进场。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, negative due to spacing, Kilo Mike 01 arrival, runway in use 36 left, information Alpha.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，因间隔原因不能同意。执行KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播Alpha。
cards.referenceText: KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: KM01进场，使用跑道36L，通播A，AFR126。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that your flap has some problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你的襟翼有故障。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, we're having trouble with our flaps.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR126，我们襟翼有故障。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 126, roger, say intention.
B: You have to hold for a check.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，收到，报告意图。你需要等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Request holing for a check, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 申请等待检查，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to Hotel Uniform Romeo, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待，AFR126。

cards.audioText: B: Operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 操作已恢复正常，申请落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，操作已恢复正常，申请落地。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, Beijing Approach, continue holding, runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，北京进近，继续等待。因大雪，跑道正在清扫，着陆性能差。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持等待，AFR126。

cards.audioText: B: There is something wrong with the nose wheel steering system, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 前轮转弯系统故障，申请落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, request a tug after landing, our nose wheel steering system failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，前轮转弯系统失效，申请落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, Air France 126, is there anything else abnormal?
B: Other systems normal, ask the  controller how long the delay is.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：收到，Air France 126，还有其他异常吗？
其他系统正常，询问管制员延误多久。
cards.referenceText: Negative, other systems normal, how long is the delay? AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，其他系统正常，请问延误多久？AFR126。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.
B: The remaining fuel can hold for half hour, you have to request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，雪越来越大，你们需要等待约1小时。剩余油量只能等待半小时，你必须申请备降。
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 30 minutes, request  diversion, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们续航时间30分钟，申请备降，AFR126。

cards.audioText:
C: Air France 126, stand by.
B: Your fuel temperature indicates
abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，请稍等。你的燃油温度指示异常，只能再等待10分钟，申请备降大连机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, our fuel temperature indicates abnormal,  endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR126，我们燃油温度指示异常，续航只剩10分钟，申请备降大连机场。

cards.audioText: C: Standby 1, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：请稍等，我们将向空军申请使用临时航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，按标准气压爬升并保持8100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持8100米，AFR126。

cards.audioText: C: Air France 126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Air France 126，直飞大连机场，联系北京管制120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to Dalian airport, 120.35, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞大连机场，120.35，AFR126。
